title: Character counter in the chat composer
problem: Users pasting long prompts only learn they exceeded the model's input limit after the request fails, losing time and sometimes the draft. It affects every endpoint whose model spec defines a max input length and is triggered by typing or pasting past that length.
users_affected: Chat users on endpoints with a configured max input length
Operators who tune model limits in librechat.yaml
goals: Show remaining characters while composing once 80% of the limit is used
Block send and explain why when the limit is exceeded

acceptance_criteria.given: interface.composerCounter.enabled is true and the model limit is 1000 characters
acceptance_criteria.then: a counter shows the remaining 200 characters
the send button is disabled and the counter states the overflow
no counter renders and sending behaves exactly as today
a polite live region announces the overflow once and the counter text is localized

ux_states.loading: n/a: the counter derives from local draft state and already-loaded startup config
ux_states.empty: No counter below 80% of the limit, including an empty draft
ux_states.success: Counter shows remaining characters in the muted text role
ux_states.error: Over the limit the counter uses the destructive text role and send is disabled
ux_states.cancel_retry: Deleting text below the limit re-enables send immediately
ux_states.restored_session: A restored draft recomputes the counter on mount

config_levers.name: interface.composerCounter.enabled
config_levers.purpose: Operators opt in to the counter

compatibility: Off by default, so existing deployments and stored drafts are unaffected; older clients ignore the new interface field.
assumptions: Model max input length is already exposed to the client in startup config
